title: PlanSplat Puts Schoolwork and Study Time in One Place
description: Meet PlanSplat, a free student planner with courses, task checklists, weekly study blocks, a focus timer, Google Drive saving, Calendar updates and reloadable backups.
author: Miguel Guhlin
imageAlt: PlanSplat Today view with fictional biology and English assignments, checklists, a focus timer and upcoming deadlines.
